Jeffrey Peter "Dr. Jeff" Datto

No Party Affiliation candidate for Governor and Lieutenant Governor, Florida · Open seat

Neuroscientist; describes himself as a patient and civil rights advocate and a "Pro Se AI Litigator"

Jeffrey Peter "Dr. Jeff" Datto, 51, is a Hialeah resident who describes himself as a neuroscientist, a patient and civil rights advocate, and a Catholic father of two. He filed with the Florida Division of Elections as a No Party Affiliation candidate for governor on 2025-12-05, with Juan Santana as his running mate. He qualified for the November 3, 2026 general election ballot by paying the qualifying fee on 2026-06-12.

Background

  • Filed for Governor (NPA) on 2025-12-05; qualified on 2026-06-12 by paying the fee; running mate Juan Santana
  • Former spinal cord injury research associate, Miami VA Healthcare System (per his Facebook profile)
  • Former spinal cord injury research associate, University of Miami (per his Facebook profile)
  • Previously worked at Duke University (per his Facebook profile)
